dates = sorted(set(o['date'] for o in orders))
date_range = f"{dates[0]} to {dates[-1]}" if len(dates) > 1 else dates[0]

# Customer breakdown
customer_counts = Counter(o['customer'] for o in orders)
top_customers = customer_counts.most_common(5)

# Product frequency
all_items = []
for o in orders:
    items = [i.strip() for i in o['items'].split(',')]
    all_items.extend(items)
product_counts = Counter(all_items)
top_products = product_counts.most_common(5)

# Average order value
avg_order = total_revenue / total_orders if total_orders > 0 else 0

# Build summary
lines = []
lines.append("Order Summary Report")
lines.append("=" * 40)
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"Date Range: {date_range}")
lines.append(f"Total Orders: {total_orders}")
lines.append(f"  - Confirmed: {len(confirmed)} ({len(confirmed)/total_orders*100:.0f}%)")
lines.append(f"  - Cancelled: {len(cancelled)} ({len(cancelled)/total_orders*100:.0f}%)")
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.0f}")
lines.append(f"Confirmed Revenue: ${confirmed_revenue:,.0f}")
lines.append(f"Average Order Value: ${avg_order:,.2f}")
lines.append("")
lines.append("Top 5 Customers by Order Count:")
for cust, cnt in top_customers:
    lines.append(f"  - {cust}: {cnt} orders")
lines.append("")
lines.append("Top 5 Most Ordered Products:")
for prod, cnt in top_products:
    lines.append(f"  - {prod}: {cnt} times")
lines.append("")
lines.append("This report was auto-generated from order_summary.xlsx.")

summary = "\\n".join(lines)
print("=== GENERATED SUMMARY ===")
print(summary)

# Save summary to file for the email step
with open("/workspace/summary.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(summary)
print("\\nSummary saved to /workspace/summary.txt")
'''

)

if result.returncode != 0:
